summary: The plugin declares the new samantha_messaging typed tool (SMS and e-mail, projected by samantha-ui-playbooks), shows it direct-only to the voice and app brain (DIRECT_TYPED_TOOLS; direct surface 38 259 characters, new ceiling 38 500), and hides alone any catalogue tool absent from contracts.tools instead of letting the Gateway refuse the whole typed batch.
reason: Owner, 08/11 after the voice recette: « la voix doit pouvoir faire cela et tout ce qui ressemble à ça » (SMS and e-mail to himself were refused: no tool). S24 31/10 15:20: one undeclared catalogue tool made the Gateway refuse every typed owner.
